newsitem.title: USA: PSE to trade ChemFirst options on Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PSE to trade ChemFirst options on Jan 14.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Monday it would list options on shares of Chemfirst Inc on Tuesday January 14.
The exchange said opening strike prices would be 20, 22-1/2 and 25, with initial expirations in February, March, April and July.

ChemFirst shares were down 3/8 at 23-1/2 Monday afternoon The company is a spin-off from First Mississippi Corp ChemFirst options have been allocated to lead market makers Michael Cole and Paul Roesler of Cole, Roesler & Associates, the PSE said.
